chapterInfo.content:
3
Nyankopɔn ho suro ne nyansa mu mfasoɔ
1Me ba, mma wo werɛ mmfiri me mmara,
na ma w’akoma nni me mmara nsɛm so;
2 # Mmb 4.10; Lew 18.5 ɛfiri sɛ onyinkyerɛ, nkwa mfeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ
na ɛde bɛka wo ho.
3 # Mmb 6.21; 7.3; Deut 6.8; Yer 31.33 Mma adɔeɛ ne nokorɛ nnnyaa wo;
fa kyekyere wo kɔn,
twerɛ no w’akoma pono so.
4 # Luk 2.52 Ɛnna wobɛnya adom ne nimdeɛ pa,
Nyankopɔn ne nnipa anim.
5Fa w’akoma nyinaa bata AWURADE ho,
na mfa wo ho ntwere w’ankasa wo nteaseɛ.
6Fa w’akwan nyinaa hyɛ ne nsa,
na ɔno na ɔbɛtene w’akwan.
7 # Yes 5.21 Nyɛ w’ani so onyansafoɔ,
suro AWURADE, na dane firi bɔne ho.
8 # Mmb 4.22 Ɛbɛyɛ ahoɔden ama wo honam,
ne nkwahosan ama wo nnompe.
9 # Eks 23.19 Fa w’ahonyadeɛ hyɛ AWURADE animuonyam,
ne wo nnɔbaeɛ mu adikan nyinaa;
10ɛnna adedodoɔ bɛyɛ w’asan amaama,
na wo nsa-kyi-amena mu nsa foforɔ bɛbu soɔ.
11 # Hiob 5.17-19; Heb 12.5-6 Me ba, mpo AWURADE nkyerɛkyerɛ,
na mma n’animka mmfono wo;
12 # Adi 3.19 na deɛ AWURADE dɔ no na ɔka n’anim,
sɛdeɛ agya yɛ ne ba a ɔdɔ no no.
13 # Mat 13.44 Nhyira ne onipa a ɔhunu nyansa,
ne onipa a ɔnya nteaseɛ.
14 # Mmb 8.10, 19 Na emu adenya yɛ sene dwetɛ deɛ,
na ne mfasoɔ sene sika amapa.
15 # Mat 13.45-46 Ne boɔ yɛ den sene mmota,
na afɛfɛdeɛ nyinaa, wɔmfa nto ho.
16 # Mmb 3.2 Onyinkyerɛ wɔ ne nifa mu,
ne benkum kura adeɛ ne animuonyam.
17N’akwan yɛ akwan a ɛyɛ fɛ,
na n’asa nyinaa yɛ asomdwoeɛ.
18Ɛyɛ nkwa dua ma wɔn a wɔsɔ ne mu,
na nhyira ne deɛ ɔkura mu.
19 # Mmb 8.24-30 AWURADE de nyansa na ɛhyɛɛ asase aseɛ,
ɔde nteaseɛ de ɔsoro tim hɔ;
20ne nimdeɛ so na abunu mu nsuo paeeɛ,
na mununkum sosɔ obosuo.
21Me ba, fa nyansa mapa ne adwempa sie,
mma no nnnane mfiri w’ani so,
22 # Mmb 1.9 na ayɛ nkwa ama wo kra
ne animuonyam ama wo kɔn.
23Ɛno na wobɛnante wo kwan so dwoodwoo,
na wo nan ansunti.
24 # Dwom 3.5; 4.8 Sɛ wokɔda a, woremmɔ binim,
na woda a, wo nna bɛyɛ dɛ.
25Nsuro mpofirim huyie
ne abɔnefoɔ sɛeɛ a ɛbɛba.
26 # Mmb 10.29 Na AWURADE bɛyɛ w’ahodasodeɛ,
na ɔbɛkora wo nan afiri ɛkyerɛ mu.
27Mfa yieyɛ nkame deɛ ɛsɛ no,
berɛ a ɛwɔ wo tumi mu sɛ wobɛyɛ no.
28Nka nkyerɛ wo yɔnko sɛ: Kɔ na bra!
ne: Ɔkyena mede bɛma,
berɛ a ɛwɔ wo hɔ.
29Mpam wo yɔnko ho apammɔne,
berɛ a ɔne wo te hɔ dwoodwoo no.
30Ɛne obi nnni ntɔkwasɛm kwa,
berɛ a ɔnyɛɛ wo bɔne biara no.
31Ntwe otirimuɔdenfoɔ ho ninkunu,
nanso nyi n’akwan mu biara.
32 # Dwom 25.14 Na ɔkɔnkɔnsani yɛ AWURADE akyiwadeɛ,
na teefoɔ na ɔne wɔn ka atirimusɛm.
33AWURADE nnome wɔ ɔbɔnefoɔ fie,
na ɔhyira ateneneefoɔ tenabea.
34 # Mmb 1.26; 1 Pe 5.5 Aane, ɔdi afɛdifoɔ ho fɛw,
na ɔdom ahobrɛasefoɔ.
35Anyansafoɔ bɛnya animuonyam adi,
na nkwaseafoɔ deɛ wɔbɛsoa ahohora.

na ma w’akoma nni me mmara nsɛm so;
ɛfiri sɛ onyinkyerɛ, nkwa mfeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ
na ɛde bɛka wo ho.
Mma adɔeɛ ne nokorɛ nnnyaa wo;
fa kyekyere wo kɔn,
twerɛ no w’akoma pono so.
Ɛnna wobɛnya adom ne nimdeɛ pa,
Nyankopɔn ne nnipa anim.
Fa w’akoma nyinaa bata AWURADE ho,
na mfa wo ho ntwere w’ankasa wo nteaseɛ.
Fa w’akwan nyinaa hyɛ ne nsa,
na ɔno na ɔbɛtene w’akwan.

suro AWURADE, na dane firi bɔne ho.
Ɛbɛyɛ ahoɔden ama wo honam,
ne nkwahosan ama wo nnompe.
Fa w’ahonyadeɛ hyɛ AWURADE animuonyam,
ne wo nnɔbaeɛ mu adikan nyinaa;
ɛnna adedodoɔ bɛyɛ w’asan amaama,
na wo nsa-kyi-amena mu nsa foforɔ bɛbu soɔ.
Me ba, mpo AWURADE nkyerɛkyerɛ,
na mma n’animka mmfono wo;
na deɛ AWURADE dɔ no na ɔka n’anim,
sɛdeɛ agya yɛ ne ba a ɔdɔ no no.
Nhyira ne onipa a ɔhunu nyansa,
ne onipa a ɔnya nteaseɛ.
Na emu adenya yɛ sene dwetɛ deɛ,
na ne mfasoɔ sene sika amapa.
Ne boɔ yɛ den sene mmota,
na afɛfɛdeɛ nyinaa, wɔmfa nto ho.
Onyinkyerɛ wɔ ne nifa mu,
ne benkum kura adeɛ ne animuonyam.
N’akwan yɛ akwan a ɛyɛ fɛ,
na n’asa nyinaa yɛ asomdwoeɛ.
Ɛyɛ nkwa dua ma wɔn a wɔsɔ ne mu,
na nhyira ne deɛ ɔkura mu.
AWURADE de nyansa na ɛhyɛɛ asase aseɛ,
ɔde nteaseɛ de ɔsoro tim hɔ;
ne nimdeɛ so na abunu mu nsuo paeeɛ,
na mununkum sosɔ obosuo.
Me ba, fa nyansa mapa ne adwempa sie,
mma no nnnane mfiri w’ani so,
na ayɛ nkwa ama wo kra
ne animuonyam ama wo kɔn.
Ɛno na wobɛnante wo kwan so dwoodwoo,
na wo nan ansunti.
Sɛ wokɔda a, woremmɔ binim,
na woda a, wo nna bɛyɛ dɛ.
Nsuro mpofirim huyie
ne abɔnefoɔ sɛeɛ a ɛbɛba.
Na AWURADE bɛyɛ w’ahodasodeɛ,
na ɔbɛkora wo nan afiri ɛkyerɛ mu.
Mfa yieyɛ nkame deɛ ɛsɛ no,
berɛ a ɛwɔ wo tumi mu sɛ wobɛyɛ no.
Nka nkyerɛ wo yɔnko sɛ: Kɔ na bra!
ne: Ɔkyena mede bɛma,
berɛ a ɛwɔ wo hɔ.
Mpam wo yɔnko ho apammɔne,
berɛ a ɔne wo te hɔ dwoodwoo no.
Ɛne obi nnni ntɔkwasɛm kwa,
berɛ a ɔnyɛɛ wo bɔne biara no.
Ntwe otirimuɔdenfoɔ ho ninkunu,
nanso nyi n’akwan mu biara.
Na ɔkɔnkɔnsani yɛ AWURADE akyiwadeɛ,
na teefoɔ na ɔne wɔn ka atirimusɛm.
AWURADE nnome wɔ ɔbɔnefoɔ fie,
na ɔhyira ateneneefoɔ tenabea.
Aane, ɔdi afɛdifoɔ ho fɛw,

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
